mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.25% indicates accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 0.25% (measured by 5-year rolling window Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in unemployment rate above 9.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 9.0% in the prior 3 months (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate weakening demand that precedes corporate profit deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns: Rank IC < 0.05 over 3-year rolling windows or negative returns occur in <40% of events.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO below 95.0) during supply chain disruptions reduces manufacturing output and increases input costs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 (measured by 5-year rolling window).

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%) triggers anticipated Federal Reserve tightening, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in residential construction (HOUST) indicates improving housing market conditions that boost consumer confidence and spending, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST shows 3-month upward momentum (Rank IC < 0.03).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment (UNRATE) and declines in employment (PAYEMS) signal severe labor market contraction that reduces household income and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS fails to predict negative returns: Rank IC < 0.05 or negative returns occur in <40% of events.

mechanism_narrative: Low inflation (CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5%) during accommodative monetary policy supports sustained equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY < 1.5% (measured by 5-year rolling window).
